This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, in connection with Crime No.98/2018, registered at Police Station Chakghat, District Rewa (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 467, 471 and 201 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and he does not have any role in the offence which is said to have been committed.
It is submitted that other co-accused persons were responsible for it.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.
He read over the statement of M. L. Ahirwar.
He has stated that applicant was also acting as representative of Manager who has embezzled huge amount of money.
Applicant is also required for custodial investigation for recovery of money.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is ready to deposit Rs.10 Lakhs as has been done by other co-accused persons.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on condition that applicant shall deposit an amount of Rs.10,00,000/-
(Rs.Ten Lakhs Only) before the trial court.
7. Amount of Rs.10,00,000/- deposited by the applicant shall be kept in a FDR with a nationalized bank and shall be subject to final outcome of judgment to be passed by the trial court.

8. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, he be released on bail on his producing receipt of deposit of Rs.10 Lakhs and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lakh only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
Certified copy as per rules.
